notes:
Account summary: Peregrine is a mid-to-large online marketplace looking to standardize inference for search, personalization and chat across NA and EU sites. Engaged Apr-Jun 2025. POC (embeddings + rerank) ran Jul-Sep with reduced latencies but was scoped to a single storefront.

Timeline / key activities:
- 2025-04-22: Intro call (AE Jordan) — high level interest in reducing cart drop via better ranking.
- 2025-05-14: Deep-dive w/ SE (Sana) on batching, KV cache, throughput targets (target 99th latency < 120ms for rerank).
- 2025-06-10: POC kickoff. Fireflies ff-2025-06-12-8673 - transcript attached.
- 2025-07 - 2025-09: POC results — embeddings quality + rerank improved CTR; cost was competitive when using quantized models and caching. Drive: /decks/peregrine-poc-pricing-2025.pdf.
- 2025-09-18: Security review meeting with infra/security (ff-2025-09-18-2201). Key asks: SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit logs, EU data residency guarantee.
- 2025-10-08: Procurement escalation — finance requests committed discount. Azure/AWS sales engaged (ff-2025-10-08-4420).
- 2025-10-21: Final decision: choose Azure OpenAI managed endpoints due to enterprise Azure contract and discounted bundling.

Why lost (summary):
- Customer already had an enterprise Azure agreement that included credits and preferred pricing for managed inference products; finance favored the bundling.
- Infra/security comfortable with native Azure managed endpoints (single pane IAM, private endpoints, integrated KMS) — reduced perceived operational risk.
- Internal champion moved teams during procurement window; no consistent exec sponsor to push migration to Redwood Dedicated/private.
- Pricing negotiation tightened; hyperscaler offer undercut our committed pricing for the initial 12 months given their existing contract.

Sales / SE notes (shorthand):
- POC showed technical fit: latency SLOs met in isolated tests; caching reduced token cost by ~30%.
- "Great tech, but too many internal constraints" — head of infra on 2025-10-12.
- Security requested SOC2 + written residency SLA; Redwood provided docs but Azure's native guarantees were perceived as stronger due to contractual simplicity.

Next steps / follow-up plan:
- Mark as closed-lost. Add to enterprise nurture cadence: check back at 6 months and 12 months, target around Azure contract renewal windows.
- Send tailored note summarizing POC outcomes and cost delta vs Azure (AE to send by 2025-11-10). Drive doc link in thread.
- If they run into scaling issues or require multi-cloud for redundancy, reopen discussion.

Linked artifacts / refs:
- Drive: /security/peregrine-security-faq-reqs.md (contains security Q&A and our responses).
- Jira: INF-2389 (POC infra bug), SEC-1124 (alignment on KMS).

Misc: customer liked our rollout options (canary + fallback) but procurement preferred single-vendor simplicity. Nurture: quarterly content on hybrid architectures and case studies showing migration ROI.
